description.zh: 在 Linux 工作区安全处理 Word/Excel/PowerPoint/PDF：ToolPkg 只做参数校验与跨环境搬运，格式逻辑全部在 Python 运行时。
description.en: Process Word/Excel/PowerPoint/PDF safely in the Linux workspace: the ToolPkg only validates arguments and bridges environments, while all format logic lives in the Python runtime.

description.zh: 环境探测、统一读取、转换、预览、校验、差异与工作区管理。
description.en: Environment probing, unified reading, conversion, preview, validation, diff, and workspace management.

description.zh: DOCX 结构读取、创建、模板填充、跨 run 查找替换与表格/图片/样式编辑。
description.en: DOCX outline, creation, template fill, cross-run find/replace, tables, images, and styles.

description.zh: XLSX 读取、写入、格式、工作表操作与 LibreOffice 公式重算。
description.en: XLSX read/write, formatting, sheet operations, and LibreOffice recalculation.

description.zh: PPTX 结构读取、生成、模板填充、幻灯片结构维护与形状编辑。
description.en: PPTX outline, generation, template fill, slide structure maintenance, and shape editing.

description.zh: PDF 信息、提取、页级操作、表单、水印、加解密、转图与生成。
description.en: PDF info, extraction, page operations, forms, watermarks, encryption, images, and creation.
